notes: Deliverable is a general streaming byte-offset editor tool verified by execution on 5 fresh hidden inputs plus a large multibyte file. Reasoning depth (byte vs code-point offset semantics, streaming merge without overshoot, validation ordering), adversarial inputs (malformed/overlapping edits must be rejected), hidden-case generalization (tool must run on arbitrary new inputs), quantitative correctness (SHA-256 + byte length must be exact). Easy on tool breadth and interaction/unsafe penalties; deterministic.
